⚽️TOURING ASSISTANT EVENT MANAGERS NEEDED – SPORTS FOOTBALL CAMPAIGN! ⚽️

Kreate are looking for experienced Assistant Event Managers to join us on an exciting Sky Sports football campaign!🙌

📅 DATES & LOCATIONS:

📍 Cardiff – 04/08

📍 Newcastle – 06/08

📍 Leeds – 10/08

📍 Livingston Sales – 12/08

📍 Livingston Service – 13/08

📍 Dunfermline – 17/08

📍 Glasgow – 18/08

📍 London – 20/08

⏰ Live Hours: 10am – 4pm

💷 RATE: £18 per hour

🚐 Travel Days + Expenses Paid

🔧 THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a confident, hands-on Assistant Event Manager to support the smooth delivery of the campaign.

You must:

✅ Have no issues with rigging and event set-up

✅ Be confident driving a Luton Box Van with Tail Lift

✅ Hold a clean UK driving licence

✅ Be comfortable with loading, unloading and moving event equipment

✅ Be reliable, organised and proactive

✅ Have previous event experience and be confident supporting an Event Manager and wider team

Help bring Sports football to life through an exciting, immersive experience featuring a series of fun and interactive challenges.

If you're an experienced event professional who is happy getting stuck in and supporting the team with both event management and practical set-up, we'd love to hear from you! 🙌

📩 Interested? Email: campaigns@kreate.co.uk

Casting Call: Amazing opportunity to feature in a paid Kellogg’s advert.

We’re looking for warm, engaging people in the UK aged 50- 65 to feature in a new Kellogg’s campaign.

Did you discover exercise later in life?

We’re not looking for lifelong gym fanatics or elite athletes. We’re looking for people who found movement at a later age, for a meaningful reason.

Maybe you wanted to keep up with your children or grandchildren. Maybe you had a health scare, found a new hobby, wanted to build your confidence, improve your wellbeing, or simply found a community that changed your life.

Whatever your reason, we’d love to hear your story.

We’re looking for people who would feel confident talking on camera and sharing the positive impact that becoming more active has had on their lives. 

The campaign celebrates real people with genuine, uplifting stories that reflect the warm, wholesome spirit of Kellogg’s.

Details:
• Ages 50 to 65
• Shoot: Week commencing 14th September
• £300 session fee
• £4,700 buyout 

If this sounds like you, or somebody you know, we’d love to hear from you.

📧 casting@casperblackcasting.com
Please include:
• Your name
• Age
• Where you’re based
• A recent photo
• A contact number
• A little about yourself and your fitness journey
As always, please feel free to share this post. The best people often come through recommendations. ❤️🫶🏼

CREW CALL- SFX/Makeup Artist 

Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a crew call for a Makeup Artist that also knows how to do light SFX designs. (If you can do hair too that is a major plus!) 

Details: 

Work: Makeup for 5 actors total. SFX for 5 actors as well (2 bruise effects, 2 shirt bleed thrus, 1 hand bleed thru- no gushing or anything complex, you just need to know how to work with sfx blood and create bruising). We welcome creativity and freehand ideas too! ☺️

Makeup is very minimal. Nothing too heavy. Just light touch ups for the actors - simple and natural. No heavy eyeliner or any complex glam! Simple and easy. SFX is mainly just bruises (1 will be minimal and 1 will be heavier) and fake blood w/ fake wound areas. 

Compensation: Volunteer based- yet we are of course willing to provide a stipend for kit fees/material costs; this is open for any and all negotiation, just please keep in mind we are a self funded, passion based project so our budget is very *limited*. You will be credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals and crafty will be provided. Copy of the film/any photos taken for portfolio/demo usage! Lastly, great networking opportunities as we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6.

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) for location #1 and location #2 still TBD but area scope is between SFV and SGV 

If you are interested please PM me, let’s chat and connect! 🥰 if you PM me, please leave a comment here so that I may be aware! Thanks so much for your time and consideration, hope to hear from you!

**CASTING CALL & CREW NOTICE FOR INDIE SHORT FILM **

**TITLE:** Truffle Pig

**GENRE:** Elevated Arthouse Horror / Psychological Thriller / Drama *(Serious, grounded, and intense tone—not campy)*

**LOGLINE:** Hunted through the rugged Colorado wilderness, a man undergoes a harrowing, visceral transformation into a porcine predator to seek karmic retribution. A dark, elevated study on trauma, vengeance, and survival.

**ABOUT THE CREATOR:**

Randy Rochford is a Colorado-based multidisciplinary artist, actor, fashion model, dancer, and writer. He specializes in high-fashion editorial, physical theater, movement, and creature performance. He is the founder of Feelin' Just Dandy Productions, through which he develops original arthouse horror and character-driven thrillers.

**CREATIVE & PRODUCTION TEAM:**
* **Writer / Creative Producer / Casting Director:** Randy Rochford *(Feelin' Just Dandy Productions | Portraying 'Ronnie')*
* **Director / Executive Producer:** Brock Mason Crone *(Pioneer Entertainment)*

**CASTING ROLES:**
* **TYLER (Lead | Male, Late-20s–Mid-30s):** The primary antagonist driving a high-stakes pursuit through the wilderness. Rugged, intimidating, and calculating, Tyler conceals a sinister nature behind a facade of false charm and psychological manipulation. He stalks his target through the night with a shotgun, treating the hunt like a game of control. Complex, intense, and emotionally demanding—requires an actor who isn't afraid to push boundaries into raw, dark, and uncomfortable psychological territory. Must be comfortable with heavy thriller elements, intensity, outdoor night shoots, and SFX makeup/blood work.
* **RONNIE:** ***ROLE FILLED by ***Randy Rochford**.** The central protagonist. A vulnerable, desperate survivor who undergoes a harrowing physical and psychological metamorphosis in the woods—pushed to his absolute limits in a desperate fight for survival.
* **EXTRAS / CORPSES (4–5 Actors/Models | Open Gender, 18+):** Needed for atmospheric scene setup. Minimal/no movement required. Must be comfortable with SFX makeup (blood/bruising) and outdoor environments.

**CREW & PRODUCTION POSITIONS NEEDED:**
* **Special Effects (SFX) Makeup Artist:** Specialized in realistic blood, bruising, skin FX, and prosthetics.
* **SFX / Makeup Continuity Supervisor:** To maintain practical/blood alignment across multi-night shoots.
* **Wardrobe Master / Costume Designer:** Managing practical outdoor gear and distressed wardrobe.
* **Gaffer & Lighting Crew:** Experience with low-light, high-contrast night exterior setups.
* **Co-Producers / Executive Producers:** Additional creative/funding partners seeking to attach to an ambitious arthouse horror project. Script and full Pitch Deck Website available upon request for serious inquiries.

**AUDITION & SUBMISSION INFORMATION:**
* **Deadline to Submit:** August 20th, 2026 by 9:00 AM MST.
* **For Tyler Submissions:** Email headshot, resume, demo reel, and/or relevant dramatic clips to **randyrochford2@gmail.com** and CC **brock@pioneerentertainment.net** with the subject line *"Tyler - [First/Last Name] - Truffle Pig"*.
   * *Note:* Selected actors will receive sides for a self-tape audition.
   * *Self-Tape Slate Requirements:* First/Last Name, Height, Location, Representation status, and explicit confirmation that you are comfortable with dark thriller themes, SFX blood/violence, and semi-nude visual elements if required.
* **For Extras / Corpse Roles:** Email a **Headshot**, **Full-Body Shot**, and **3/4 Shot** (no reels or complex resumes required) to the emails above with the subject line *"EXTRA: Truffle Pig"*.
* **Crew & Production Applicants:** Email resume, portfolio/website link, and equipment/dept list to both emails listed above with the subject line *"CREW: [Department Name] - Truffle Pig"*.

**COMPENSATION:** Paid (NON-UNION), IMDb Credit, Meals/Craft Services provided, and Copy/Footage for reel.

**PRODUCTION TYPE:** Non-Union Independent Arthouse Short Film

**SHOOTING SCHEDULE:** 4–5 Night Shoots in Late July / Early August 2027 *(late-night exterior filming)*

**FILMING LOCATION:** Mountainous area surrounding Denver, CO

O

🎬 **CASTING CALL – VOLUNTEER ACTORS NEEDED FOR AN INDIE FEATURE FILM** 🎬

We're casting for an upcoming scene in our **no-budget independent feature film,** and are looking for passionate performers who'd like to be part of a meaningful storytelling project.

**🎭 PRINCIPAL ROLES**

**1. Immigration Officer**
* **Gender:** Female
* **Ethnicity:** Open
* **Age:** 25–40 years
* **Dialogue:** 9 lines

**Character Description:**
A professional immigration officer who checks in the lead characters when they arrive at the airport. She is **strong, focused, empathetic, direct, and efficient**.

⭐ **Bonus:** If you already own a uniform or wardrobe suitable for an immigration officer, that's a plus.

**2. Chief Immigration Officer – Gurinder**
* **Gender:** Female
* **Ethnicity:** Indian
* **Age:** 30–45 years
* **Dialogue:** 2 lines

**Character Description:**
A senior immigration officer who is **strong, honest, loyal, supportive, empathetic, and straightforward**.

⭐ **Bonus:** If you already own a uniform or wardrobe suitable for an immigration officer, that's a plus.

**🎬 20 BACKGROUND ACTORS NEEDED**
* **Ethnicity:** Indian, Southeast Asian & African
* **Gender:** Open
* **Age:** 25+

These performers will help bring our airport immigration scenes to life.

🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Roland Puschitz über Kunstvermittlung. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 173. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 11.08.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Plaudermeeting: Kunst und Wirtschaft – Kooperationen mit Unternehmen 
🎙️ Moderation: Monika Medek 

Ob Sponsoring, Auftragsarbeiten oder CSR-Partnerschaften: Kunst kann für Unternehmen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – in der Kommunikation, im gesellschaftlichen Engagement, bei der Mitarbeiter*innen-Bindung oder als Impuls für Innovation. 

Doch welche Schnittstellen gibt es zwischen Kultur und Wirtschaft? Welche Kooperationsmöglichkeiten lassen sich entwickeln? Und wie formuliere ich ein Angebot so, dass es für Unternehmen attraktiv, verständlich und relevant ist? 

In diesem interaktiven Plaudermeeting sprechen wir über Strategien, Argumente und konkrete Ansätze, mit denen sich künstlerische Projekte erfolgreich im unternehmerischen Umfeld positionieren lassen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die neue Partnerschaften aufbauen, ihre Projekte professionell präsentieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunst und Wirtschaft aktiv gestalten möchten. 

©Congerdesign

Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at

items.text:
🎬 **Schauspieler / Kleindarsteller / Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

Hallo zusammen,

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Ich bin aktuell auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse** – gerne für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme oder andere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte in erster Linie weitere Erfahrungen vor der Kamera sammeln, mich weiterentwickeln und verschiedene Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche bekommen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits als **Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude gemacht und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig noch häufiger vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig** und freue mich darauf, neue Erfahrungen zu sammeln und mich auf unterschiedliche Projekte einzulassen.

Ich bin sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** offen. Anfragen aus Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich über eine Nachricht. **Aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** sende ich gerne auf Anfrage zu.

Ich freue mich über interessante Projekte, neue Erfahrungen und nette Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche!

Viele Grüße
**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍

items.text:
WE'RE HIRING — LAPLANDUK 2026
Pay: £12.25–£14.50 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

You must be 18 or over to apply.

LaplandUK is now recruiting for Christmas 2026.

Every year, more than 180,000 guests visit LaplandUK to experience one of the UK's most celebrated immersive Christmas events. We're looking for friendly, enthusiastic people to help create magical memories for families across a range of seasonal roles.

We're recruiting for:

Magic Elf – Bring the magical world of LaplandUK to life through storytelling, performance and unforgettable guest interactions.

Guest Experience Host – Welcome and guide families through their magical LaplandUK journey, ensuring every guest has an exceptional experience.

Retail Assistant – Help guests find the perfect gifts, operate tills and deliver outstanding customer service in our festive shops.

Food & Beverage Assistant – Operate tills, serve food and drinks while creating a warm, friendly and efficient dining experience.

Ice Skater – Support families at our Frozen Pond as a Skate Hire Assistant or Ice Marshal, helping guests enjoy the ice safely and confidently.

What's included:

Paid seasonal contract (November to December), including paid training

£12.25–£14.50 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

Flexible shifts available across 7 days a week

Free shuttle service from the nearest train station

Free on-site parking

Free hot meal on every shift

Please note:

No previous experience required

Must be available for at least 3 shifts per week

No visible neck or lower arm tattoos due to costume requirements

To apply:

Complete our Google Form using the link below. Once you've submitted the form, our Recruitment Team will review your details and contact you with the next steps.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVhuxLIfQqIE_UAKZDaXmp5BufJ3P-UU5jZKwqERX7JwRLHw/viewform

Any questions?

Please email resourcing@lapland.group and a member of the Recruitment Team will be happy to help.

Please share this post or tag someone who would love to be part of creating magical Christmas memories at LaplandUK.

WE'RE HIRING — LAPLANDUK 2026
Pay: £12.25–£14.50 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

You must be 18 or over to apply.

LaplandUK is now recruiting for Christmas 2026.

Every year, more than 180,000 guests visit LaplandUK to experience one of the UK's most celebrated immersive Christmas events. We're looking for friendly, enthusiastic people to help create magical memories for families across a range of seasonal roles.

We're recruiting for:

Magic Elf – Bring the magical world of LaplandUK to life through storytelling, performance and unforgettable guest interactions.

Guest Experience Host – Welcome and guide families through their magical LaplandUK journey, ensuring every guest has an exceptional experience.

Retail Assistant – Help guests find the perfect gifts, operate tills and deliver outstanding customer service in our festive shops.

Food & Beverage Assistant – Operate tills, serve food and drinks while creating a warm, friendly and efficient dining experience.

Ice Skater – Support families at our Frozen Pond as a Skate Hire Assistant or Ice Marshal, helping guests enjoy the ice safely and confidently.

What's included:

Paid seasonal contract (November to December), including paid training

£12.25–£14.50 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

Flexible shifts available across 7 days a week

Free shuttle service from the nearest train station

Free on-site parking

Free hot meal on every shift

Please note:

No previous experience required

Must be available for at least 3 shifts per week

No visible neck or lower arm tattoos due to costume requirements

To apply:

Complete our Google Form using the link below. Once you've submitted the form, our Recruitment Team will review your details and contact you with the next steps.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVhuxLIfQqIE_UAKZDaXmp5BufJ3P-UU5jZKwqERX7JwRLHw/viewform

Any questions?

Please email resourcing@lapland.group and a member of the Recruitment Team will be happy to help.

Please share this post or tag someone who would love to be part of creating magical Christmas memories at LaplandUK.

✨ Open Casting Call ✨

Pilot is unpaid (there is a ROI strategy, profit share)

If thats okay please get in touch, some details below

Romance Series (Pilot Episode)

Potential for multiple episodes.

We're casting for the pilot episode of a new romance series, with plans to continue into multiple episodes.

The story follows Andy and Jessica, who meet at a bar, instantly connect, and end up spending a romantic evening together.

Filming: two to three nights

Late september/early-mid October 2026

Location: Manchester

We are looking for three actors to play the lead roles of Andy, Jessica, and Sasha.

Manchester-based actors are preferred, but performers from all locations are welcome to apply.

Open Casting:

The casting session will take place in Manchester city centre.

To register your interest and receive more information, please send your CV/ headshots/showreel/spotlighy via

 CloudsProductionCrew@gmail.com

Producer: @aatifatizafarofficial

@tyler.mary7

Co-Producer: @Aiechaonfilm

Director: @aatifatizafarofficial

Please Note:

This is an ambitious production with high creative standards, and we're looking for dedicated performers who are excited to help bring these characters to life.

Roles:

Jessica

Playing Age: 20–30

Appearance: Must be blonde

An intelligent, confident woman who always knows what she wants. She has a magnetic presence and naturally commands attention whenever she enters a room.

Character Inspiration: Jessica was loosely inspired by Megara from Disney's Hercules. 

We're looking for the right performance and delivery.

**PAID ACTING OPPORTUNITY - SCOTTISH SHORT FILM**

We're casting the lead role for an upcoming **non-verbal** independent short film shooting in **December 2026.** This role relies entirely on subtle, authentic emotional storytelling with a focus on **micro-expressions, physical performance.**

We're looking for an actor who can deliver a deeply nuanced and emotionally truthful performance through expression alone.

**Pay:** **£300 per day**
**Shoot Length:** 3 days
**Travel:** Provided for the successful candidate where required, regardless of location - we are looking for someone who can fulfil this role.

**Logline**

*A young man imprisoned by anxiety and the past struggles to maintain his carefully ordered life when an unexpected disruption leaves him facing the one thing he fears most: stepping outside.*

**The Role**

* **Male**
* **Playing age:** 25–50

**Location**

Filming will take place in **Perth and Kinross, Scotland**.

While the shoot is based in Perth and Kinross, **casting is open across Scotland** and England, Wales, Ireland. We are looking for the actor best suited to the role, and **travel will be provided** for the successful candidate regardless of location.

**Submission Requirements**

Please send:

* Your **showreel** (preferred) or examples of relevant previous work.
* A recent headshot and/or Spotlight profile (if available).

If you believe you can bring this character to life through subtle, emotionally precise performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send submissions email: **[contact@fourthordinal.com](mailto:contact@fourthordinal.com)**

włosy niewygolone maszynką,
bez współczesnych fryzur.

imienia i nazwiska, wieku, wzrostu, informacji o posiadanych tatuażach, numeru telefonu.

Your next breakthrough won't happen by watching acting reels and tips online. 

It happens in the room.

Every actor reaches a point where talent isn't enough.

You know the lines.
You understand the scene.
But something still feels... performed.

That's where the real work begins.
Our 3-Month Intensive Acting Class is built for actors who want more than techniques-they want a process they can rely on. Through the marriage of improvisation and text, you'll learn to listen deeply, make bold choices, trust your instincts, and create performances that feel truthful every single time.

This isn't about becoming a different actor.
It's about becoming a more honest one.

• Certified upon completion
→ Live Online

• Our First Fall Batch
: Limited Seats
The actors who grow the most aren't the ones waiting for the perfect opportunity-they're the ones preparing before it arrives.
Your next audition could change your career.
The question is...
Will you be ready when it does?
DM us "FALL" to receive the full course details and
secure your seat before the Early Bird offer ends.

Date: Saturday 29th OR Sunday 30th August 2026

Style: Jazz

We are looking for a talented musician(s) who can bring that glamorous, vintage Jazz atmosphere to the event and help create a truly memorable experience for guests. 

Experience performing live is preferred, and we are particularly interested in performers who can capture the La La Land and classic jazz aesthetic! 

💰PAID OPPORTUNITY 💰

🚨URGENT: We need to confirm with our client ASAP, so if this sounds like you and you’re available, please get in touch as soon as possible!

👋 A short introduction 
🗓️ Your availability for 29th and/ or 30th August 
📍 Your location 
🎥 A performance video/ show reel or examples of your work 
💵 Your performance rate 

Email: wishuponastareventsltd@gmail.com 

Please feel free to share or tag any jazz performers you know 🎷✨

✨Making dreams come true✨

CASTING CALL- JANE
UPDATE: SUBMISSIONS CLOSED THANK YOU EVERYONE 🥰

Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our lead characters - Jane

Description: 

JANE

Woman; 30 to 37 years old; Eastern European, Hispanic, Mediterranean, Mixed Ethnicity, White. A Senior GND (Gang and Narcotics Division) Detective with the LAPD. Jane is a sharp, fiercely capable investigator defined by a rare combination of tactical caution and deep empathy. She is protectively loyal with a sharp, tactical caution, remaining empathic until the moment she needs to be lethal. She shares an unflinching, brotherly bond with her partner, Aslan, and treats his family as her own. The role demands an actress who can seamlessly transition from a grounded, protective presence to a fierce, high-stakes tactical operator, culminating in a deeply emotional and tragic climax. 

Requires the use of a non-firing replica gun. Armorer provided. Role involves falling on the floor after gun shots, stunt coordinator and the stunt crash pads for safety will be present on set.

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a micro budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6. Table read most likely Aug 8/9. Rehearsals (2-3) to happen during week of Aug 9. And again week of Aug 16 and 23. 

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) for location #1, location #2 TBD 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (bruises, blood, gs wounds) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

sharedPost.text: W 2018 roku uzyskałem na okres sześciu miesięcy patronat medialny TVP3 w celu realizacji mojego autorskiego zamysłu o nazwie #projektlila. Składa się on z kilku istotnych elementów: fabuły, scenariusza serialu, odcinka pilotażowego słuchowiska (nagranego z grupą zaprzyjaźnionych aktorów), ebooka oraz audiobooka, w którym miałem przyjemność wystąpić jako lektor. W skład projektu wchodzą również film dokumentalny, genialna adaptacja sceniczna napisana przez mojego przyjaciela na kanwie mojego opowiadania, a także książki: „Lila” (dwa wydania, PWN) oraz „Lilka” (dwa wydania, wydawca Cezary Andrzej Krajewski #cezaryandrzejkrajewski). Podczas trwania patronatu medialnego na antenie TVP3 zrealizowałem kilka programów promujących to przedsięwzięcie. Niestety, w 2020 roku wybuchła pandemia, następnie pojawiła się inflacja, a w 2022 roku doszło do inwazji na Ukrainę. Każde z tych wydarzeń uniemożliwiło mi dokończenie mojego konspektu – a dokładnie sztuki teatralnej oraz najważniejszego elementu całego pomysłu, czyli filmu fabularnego. Głęboko wierzę, że w dzisiejszych czasach uda mi się w końcu sfinalizować ten plan, czego życzę sobie z całego serca, ponieważ jest to dla mnie niezwykle ważne przedsięwzięcie. Trzymajcie mocno kciuki za pomyślność realizacji tego pomysłu! ✊✊

items.text:
🎬 CAST & CREW CALL — (Short Film) — Pueblo / Colorado Springs

Moonstream Pictures is casting a short comedy thriller shooting in the Pueblo / Colorado Springs area.

THE FILM: Kaylee, 22, just got fired and rent was due Tuesday. Her best friend tells her about an app — contract work, pick your own jobs, pays same night.

ROLES (both female, 18–25):

KAYLEE — LEAD. Warm, funny, a little in over her head. Starts the movie treating a threatening message like a customer service call and ends it somewhere very different.

BRITT — SUPPORTING LEAD. Kaylee's best friend. Knows more than she's saying. Quiet, level.

No experience required. If you've done a little acting, a lot of acting, or nothing at all and you've just always wanted to try — audition.

CREW — COME LEARN ON SET:

This is a set for people who want to do the job, not fetch coffee while somebody else does it. Everybody gets hands on gear.

MAKEUP / SFX — everyday looks plus practical blood effects. Messy, fun, and we'll walk you through it.

GRIP — rigging, stands, flags, moving and shaping light. The best crash course in how a set actually works.

SOUND — boom operator / location recordist. Hugely in demand and almost nobody in this area does it well. Learn it and you'll never be out of work.

ANY OTHER ROLE YOU'VE BEEN WANTING TO TRY — camera assistant, script supervisor, gaffer, production assistant, editor, BTS photographer. If there's a job on a film set you've been curious about and can't get anyone to let you try, tell me which one. We'll find a way to put you in it.

You do not need experience, gear, or a reel. You need to show up on time and be willing to learn. Everyone's a first-timer once, and this is a good place to be one.

THE DEAL — please read:

Unpaid.

Food and gas covered for every shoot day.

Full credit on the film and IMDb.

Footage for your reel, plus a copy of the finished short.

Small crew, short days, genuinely fun set. Meet some good people and network.

SCHEDULE: Shoot dates are still being set. Since this is a low-budget volunteer production, we'll do our best to build the schedule around what works for the people who sign on — jobs, school, and all of it. Tell us your availability and we'll work with it.

CONTENT NOTE: The film contains intense scenes, stage blood, and a physical struggle between the two leads. Nothing sexual, nothing nude. Choreographed and rehearsed, safety first, always. Please only apply if you're comfortable with that material — happy to talk through it before you commit.

TO APPLY: Reach out with a photo, your age, and anything you've done (or "nothing yet," which is a perfectly good answer as long as you can record yourself with a phone doing some auditions). Sides available for audition on request.

📩 Message me here on Facebook

📷 Instagram: @moonstreampics

✉️ Email: moonstreampictures@gmail.com

Full script available to anyone who's seriously interested.

topComments.text: I have some experience and equipment.  Lightning, audio, cameras, jib, slider dollies and more.

items.text:
CASTING CALL FOR PROOF OF CONCEPT SHORT FILM

Are you a collaborator, ready for an opportunity? If you’re ready to take a leap to do something you’ve always wanted to do, with someone ready to give you that chance, THIS is the movie for you. I’m seeking dynamic, smart, funny cast members to shoot  a comedy scene from my feature, Cheddar Pop. 

“Cheddar Pop, is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.”

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”
Location: Greater Parker, CO. Area

Shoot Dates: September 1, 2026 must be available for rehearsals week of August 21-28. 

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, meals provided. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

4 roles available. 2 female 2 male ages 18-25, Any level of experience. 

GEORGIA – Age 22—Theater Crew
Disgruntled and disillusioned, Georgia is stuck in a job that used to be her dream but now is draining her of all enthusiasm.

STELLA – Age 21—Theater Crew
Georgia’s best friend and greatest champion. Bubbly, energetic, and enthusiastic.

ROBBIE—Age 21—Theater Crew
Took a job at the theater for summer at the same time as his friend Kevin. The money’s okay for now, but always looking for something better. Just passing time.

KEVIN—Age 19—Theater Crew
Robbie’s best friend. Loves working at the theater because it keeps him close to his first passion, movies.

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by August 14, 2026.

topComments.text: I'm definitely interested, but I'm 28. I got mistaken a lot for a 19-23 years old person though

Bonjour à toutes et à tous !

Je cherche encore des H et des F tous âges d’origine coréenne pour le Lundi 10 AOÛT( surtout des hommes )pour un tournage dans PARIS( 8eme ).

Horaires prévisionnels : 08h30/19h00

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer impérativement vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 07 et le 14 août. 

Rémunération : cachet 98 euros bruts + éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a + majoration silhouette 42,24 si applicable.

Pour le LUNDI 10 AOÛT 

-Des H/F CORÉENS, pour incarner une délégation de l’ONU puis des clients très sélects de ce même restaurant 

-Des hommes et des femmes entre 30 et 55 ans( âge apparent ), toutes origines, très BCBG, physiques type mannequins bienvenus, avec une garde robe très luxe.

Pour incarner la clientèle d’un restaurant réservé à l’élite. 

Pour le VENDREDI 14 AOÛT :

Un couple très chic en silhouette avec éventuellement un véhicule de luxe( défraiement prévu pour la voiture )

Il n’y a pas d’autres dates prévues sur Paris avant la rentrée merci donc de ne pas postuler si vous n’êtes pas disponibles sur cette période. 

Pour toutes et tous, merci par avance de ne pas postuler si vous ne correspondez pas et DE NE PAS POSTULER à nouveau si vous avez déjà postulé.

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «  02 AOÛT COUNTRY CLUB Marc SIMON, 35 ans, 1m80, 78kg joueur TENNIS pro » ou « Homme Métis, Martin BRILLON, , 40 ans, 1m80, 70kg » etc, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre IMPÉRATIVEMENT les éléments suivants sinon elle ne sera pas traitée :

-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 07 AOÛT et le 14 AOÛT 

-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 

-Origines ethniques 

-Couleur des yeux

-Couleur des cheveux 

- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)

- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 

-Date et lieu de naissance 

-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )

-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )

-Préciser votre niveau de tennis ou de squash si vous pratiquez ces sports 

-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient etc etc 

-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. car nous cherchons régulièrement des gens aux looks atypiques( pas trop sur ce projet mais on ne sait jamais 😉

-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 

-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !

-N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues de sport si vous disposez de tenues très luxes/classes 

-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sportifs, sécu etc … )

N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.

-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 

-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.

-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 

-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )

-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture

-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 

-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais

Uas.casting@gmail.com

Monteur vidéo – Disponible pour vos projets ! 🎬
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Je m’appelle Matthew Dehlinger et je propose désormais mes services en tant que monteur vidéo.

Le montage est une véritable passion pour moi depuis plusieurs années. J’ai notamment réalisé le montage de mes propres courts-métrages, bandes-annonces, teasers, vidéos promotionnelles ainsi que de nombreux formats destinés aux réseaux sociaux.

Aujourd’hui, je souhaite mettre cette expérience au service d’autres personnes et collaborer sur de nouveaux projets.

Je peux notamment réaliser :
• Le montage de courts-métrages !
• Des bandes-annonces et teasers !
• Des vidéos promotionnelles !
• Des vidéos pour les réseaux sociaux !
• Et d’autres projets selon vos besoins !

Je suis à l’écoute de vos idées et je prends le temps de réaliser un montage qui correspond à vos attentes. Des retouches sont bien sûr possibles afin d’obtenir le meilleur résultat.

Je propose actuellement des tarifs de lancement, le temps de développer mon activité et d’enrichir mon portfolio ! 💰

Vous trouverez ci-dessous plusieurs exemples de mes réalisations. Toutes les vidéos présentées ont été montées par mes soins.

https://youtube.com/@thefivestarsstudio?si=iV8duhnGeYQ1b6B9

https://youtu.be/-iAUApGW5Sk?is=IPXELDNz3IoRpXe8

Vous pouvez également découvrir d’autres projets sur le compte Instagram de mes courts-métrages.

https://www.instagram.com/thefivestarsstudio?igsh=cmc5cDZib2RnMHlz

📩 Pour toute question ou pour discuter de votre projet, n’hésitez pas à me contacter en message privé ou directement sur mon compte Instagram.

https://www.instagram.com/matth_117d?igsh=MW1icHR4eTh6M2k5Zw==

Au plaisir de collaborer avec vous !

Matthew Dehlinger

Ausbildung mit Verantwortung: Mobilität für das Kinderheim Machern - Für diesen Film besuchen wir einen regionalen Ausbildungsbetrieb in der Nähe des Kinderheims Machern. Dort lernen junge Menschen praxisnah den Umgang mit Fahrzeugtechnik, Wartung und Reparatur. Gleichzeitig sorgt der Betrieb dafür, dass die Fahrzeuge des Kinderheims regelmäßig überprüft und zuverlässig instand gehalten werden. 

Diese Zusammenarbeit verbindet berufliche Bildung mit sozialer Verantwortung. Die Fahrzeuge ermöglichen Fahrten zu Schulen, Therapien, Freizeitangeboten, Terminen und gemeinsamen Ausflügen. Ihre technische Sicherheit ist deshalb eine wichtige Voraussetzung für den funktionierenden Alltag der Einrichtung. 

Christian Weiße und Karrideo setzen bei diesem Projekt fünf besondere Produktionsschwerpunkte: 

Verständliche Darstellung technischer Ausbildungsinhalte für ein breites Publikum 

Visuelle Verbindung zwischen Werkstattarbeit und dem Alltag des Kinderheims 

Authentische Aufnahmen von Wartung, Werkzeugen und praktischen Arbeitsabläufen 

Regionale Arbeitgeberdarstellung mit Blick auf Ausbildung und Zukunftsperspektiven 

Klare Filmstruktur zwischen sozialem Nutzen, Fachkompetenz und Mobilität 

Der Film zeigt, dass ein Ausbildungsbetrieb weit mehr leistet als Fahrzeugservice. Er vermittelt Wissen, schafft berufliche Chancen und unterstützt gleichzeitig eine soziale Einrichtung in der Region. 

So wird sichtbar, wie Handwerk, Nachwuchsförderung und Jugendhilfe gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen und dauerhaft voneinander profitieren.

Ausbildung mit Verantwortung: Mobilität für das Kinderheim Machern - Für diesen Film besuchen wir einen regionalen Ausbildungsbetrieb in der Nähe des Kinderheims Machern. Dort lernen junge Menschen praxisnah den Umgang mit Fahrzeugtechnik, Wartung und Reparatur. Gleichzeitig sorgt der Betrieb dafür, dass die Fahrzeuge des Kinderheims regelmäßig überprüft und zuverlässig instand gehalten werden. 

Diese Zusammenarbeit verbindet berufliche Bildung mit sozialer Verantwortung. Die Fahrzeuge ermöglichen Fahrten zu Schulen, Therapien, Freizeitangeboten, Terminen und gemeinsamen Ausflügen. Ihre technische Sicherheit ist deshalb eine wichtige Voraussetzung für den funktionierenden Alltag der Einrichtung. 

Christian Weiße und Karrideo setzen bei diesem Projekt fünf besondere Produktionsschwerpunkte: 

Verständliche Darstellung technischer Ausbildungsinhalte für ein breites Publikum 

Visuelle Verbindung zwischen Werkstattarbeit und dem Alltag des Kinderheims 

Authentische Aufnahmen von Wartung, Werkzeugen und praktischen Arbeitsabläufen 

Regionale Arbeitgeberdarstellung mit Blick auf Ausbildung und Zukunftsperspektiven 

Klare Filmstruktur zwischen sozialem Nutzen, Fachkompetenz und Mobilität 

Der Film zeigt, dass ein Ausbildungsbetrieb weit mehr leistet als Fahrzeugservice. Er vermittelt Wissen, schafft berufliche Chancen und unterstützt gleichzeitig eine soziale Einrichtung in der Region. 

So wird sichtbar, wie Handwerk, Nachwuchsförderung und Jugendhilfe gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen und dauerhaft voneinander profitieren. 

#Kinderheim #Machern #Ausbildungsbetrieb #KFZHandwerk #Karrideo

Mit Agentur Filmgesichter – Ich gehöre jetzt zu seinen/ihren Top-Fans! 🎉 

Das nehme ich doch sehr gern mit. Wer regelmäßig Castings, Produktionen und die Menschen dahinter verfolgt, darf offenbar irgendwann ganz offiziell das Top-Fan-Schild tragen.

Aber viel interessanter finde ich, was hinter Agentur Filmgesichter steckt: Ihr besetzt Kompars:innen und Kleindarsteller:innen für Film- und Fernsehproduktionen und seid aktuell unter anderem in Berlin/Brandenburg, Thüringen, Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt, NRW und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern aktiv. 

Auf Eurer Seite finden sich aktuell beispielsweise Castings für eine große historische Filmproduktion in Görlitz sowie „Einspruch, Schatz!“ in Leipzig. In der Vergangenheit ging es bei Euch sogar um Tausende Filmgesichter für große Produktionen. 

Da kommen mir als Darsteller natürlich direkt ein paar Fragen an Euch:

Welche Eigenschaften sorgen bei Euch dafür, dass jemand aus einer großen Kartei immer wieder für Produktionen angefragt wird?

Wie wichtig sind Euch neben aktuellen Fotos und vollständigen Profildaten bereits vorhandene Dreherfahrung, Setroutine und kurzfristige Verfügbarkeit?

Und eine Frage interessiert mich besonders: Welche Typen und Spielalter werden von Euren Produktionen momentan am häufigsten gesucht, gerade in NRW?

Vielleicht verratet Ihr ja ein bisschen aus der Castingpraxis. Ich bin gespannt auf Eure Antwort und freue mich, Euch als frisch ausgezeichneter „Top-Fan“ weiter zu verfolgen. 

Agentur Filmgesichter Webseite https://www.agenturfilmgesichter.de/filmgesichter 

Christian Weiße aka Karrideo Imagefilm-Produktion

items.text:
Every week actors tell us they're "too" something.

Too old.
Too young.
Too Black.
Too Indigenous.
Too Asian.
Too white.
Too gay.
Too different.

We’ve heard every version.

**But I've seen more actors hold themselves back than I've ever seen casting hold them back.**

As a former agent, I learned something that changed the way I coach actors forever. It made me realize that waiting for permission is one of the fastest ways to stall a career.

In this free class, we talk about why Hollywood has changed, why there are more opportunities than many actors realize, and what you can do to become ready for the opportunities that are still being written.

**I'd love to know what you think after you watch it.**

🎬 Replay:
[https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI](https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI)

I got a phone call the other day from the director of my film that it will be making its California debut at the Mann's Chinese Theater in Hollywood in September!!

I know a lot of people may not realize the significance of it playing there but this is the place where all the big movies make their debut!!  And while mine may not be a full length film (yet) and it is part of a larger ensemble (film festival), the very fact that I can share the same playground where some of the biggest movies have premiered, is still pretty special to me!!

I'll post updates as they become available.  Would love to see a lot of you there!!

Open Call In Person Auditions Mon. & Tues. Aug. 10 & 11 at 7pm for Betty's Summer Vacation by Christopher Durang, Directed by Bernard Bosio. Performances: Oct. 9-18: Fri. & Sat. 8pm & Sundays 2pm + Sat. Oct. 17 2pm, More Details @ [https://www.facebook.com/share/1PzZbFzE5Z/](https://www.facebook.com/share/1PzZbFzE5Z/) Auditions @HeightsPlayers 26 Willow Place Brooklyn, NY 11201. (718) 237-2752. Please bring your headshot and resume. Sides will be provided. Monologues (optional) if there is time.

CHARACTER BREAKDOWN: We are seeking a diverse cast of performers, all races, genders and identities are encouraged to audition.

​BETTY: a nice, pretty normal young woman, late twenties. Sensible, does her best to be reasonable.

TRUDY: friendly, chatty, needy, rather desperate underneath. A bit younger than Betty.

KEITH: sensitive, quiet, mysterious. Late twenties. Finds it hard to be around people. Seems sweet, seems weird.

BUCK: handsome, sexy lout-hunk. Might look like a beach guy out of Baywatch. Unabashedly sexist, on the make all the time.

MRS. SIEZMAGRAFF: lively, vibrant woman, mid-forties; oblivious to anyone else's discomfort. Auntie Mame-ish.

MR. VANISLAW: an insane derelict who exposes himself to women in bathrooms; naked except for raincoat and sneakers. A little scary, but also just insane. Happy in his way.

THE GROUP OF VOICES: two men, one woman. They laugh, they applaud. They live in the ceiling.

NO pay.

items.text:
THE THING IN THE BACK SEAT
A Student Horror Short Film

“Beauty. Night. Fear.”

Smile Time Studios is looking for passionate filmmakers to join the crew of The Thing in the Back Seat, a stylish psychological horror short inspired by the visual language of Suspiria (1977) and the suspense of Halloween and Friday the 13th. The screenplay follows Gale, whose late-night drive home turns into a terrifying encounter with an unseen presence lurking in the back seat.

Whether you’re building your portfolio, gaining set experience, or looking to collaborate with other filmmakers, we’d love to hear from you.

CREW POSITIONS

🎤 Boom Operator

Operate the boom microphone during production.

Work closely with the Sound Mixer to capture clean dialogue.

Maintain proper mic placement while remaining out of frame.

🎬 Production Assistant (PA)

Assist departments as needed throughout the shoot.

Help with set organization, equipment movement, talent support, and general production tasks.

Great opportunity for those looking to gain on-set experience.

🎨 Art Production Assistant

Assist the Production Designer/Art Department.

Help with props, dressing the set, continuity, and maintaining the film’s visual aesthetic.

Ideal for someone interested in production design or art direction.

💾 Digital Imaging Technician (DIT) / Data Wrangler

Manage camera media throughout production.

Back up footage to multiple drives.

Verify media integrity and organize footage for post-production.

Experience with file management is preferred.

📸 Behind-the-Scenes Photographer

Capture high-quality production stills throughout the night.

Photograph cast, crew, and behind-the-scenes moments.

Images will be used for social media, IMDb, press materials, and future marketing.

PRODUCTION INFORMATION

Production Type: Student Short Film

Union Status: Non-Union

Compensation: Unpaid

IMDb credit, meals, copy of the completed film, and valuable on-set experience will be provided.

FILMING LOCATION

📍 Bowling Green, Kentucky

PRINCIPAL PHOTOGRAPHY

Arrival Time: Saturday, December 5, 2026 — 8:00 PM

Filming Begins: Saturday, December 5, 2026 — 10:00 PM

Wrap: Sunday, December 6, 2026 — 6:00 AM

Please note that this is an overnight shoot.

HOW TO APPLY

Please email:

📧 Crewcoordinator.Smiletime@gmail.com

Include:

Your name

The crew position(s) you’re interested in

Resume (if available)

Relevant experience (professional, student, or personal projects)

Any examples of previous work (optional but encouraged)

WHO SHOULD APPLY?

We’re looking for reliable, collaborative people who are passionate about filmmaking. Students, recent graduates, and emerging filmmakers are encouraged to apply. Previous set experience is appreciated but not required for every position—we value enthusiasm, professionalism, and a willingness to learn.

Come help us bring The Thing in the Back Seat to life and create something unforgettable.

***SEEKING A MALE ACTOR & STAGE MANAGER***

True Repertory Theatre seeks an actor and stage manager for its October production of HOLD PLEASE!

HOLD PLEASE is an original play and the 4th that True Repertory Theatre has produced since 2022. It chronicles my personal journey with kidney disease/transplantation, working in call centers and running a theater company.

DETAILS:

ACTOR:

Seeking an actor age 50-65 to play a kidney doctor and kidney donor & other potential roles. This is a non paid acting position. If interested, please email truerepertorytheatre@gmail.com with a headshot and resume. 

STAGE MANAGER:

The stage manager will need to be present for rehearsals, tech week and performances. This is a paid position and compensation will be based on experience. If interested, please email truerepertorytheatre@gmail.com with your resume.

PRODUCTION DETAILS:

REHEARSALS:

August 16-October 8. 

Rehearsals will take place on Tuesday & Thursday evening and Sunday (Time TBD). Two weeks prior to tech week, we will add Monday evenings.

TECH WEEK:

October 11-16

PERFORMANCES:

October 17   8pm
October 18   3pm
October 23   8pm
October 24   3pm & 8pm
October 25   3pm & STRIKE

LOCATION:

All rehearsals and performances will take place at The Beal House, 222 Main St., Kingston, MA. 

Thank you!

Looking for male talent and background actors for various roles filming in Burbank over the next three weeks. Availability for multiple days is strongly preferred.

**PROJECT DETAILS**

**Rate:** $135 for 8 hours

**Location:** Burbank High School

**OPEN ROLES AND DATES **

**Monday, August 10:** 3 Males to play Students (Must be comfortable in swim trunks)

**Tuesday, August 11:** 3 Males to play Students

**Thursday, August 20:** 1 Male Shopper (Any age) and 2 Male College Partiers (Visible tattoos allowed with clearance)

**Friday, August 21:** 4 Males to play Students (Overnight shoot)

hey everyone !!! excited to be looking for collaborators in this group again for a short film titled Whitey On The Moon, a recreation of the spoken word poem by Gil Scott Heron, through the present lens !! Whether you are familiar with the poem or not, it is very powerful and truly timeless and inspired this experimental-thriller remake i’m creating !! 

The filming dates will be early September, in Los Angeles ! This is a credit, meal and copy collaboration, non-union, most likely a 1 day shoot with the following positions available: 

- casting director 

- editor

- composer

- VFX artist 

if this peeks your interest (or maybe someone you know) at all please email me for more details about this project’s vision and message 

thank you

jesseaaann@gmail.com

Hi everyone! My name is Maayan, I’m a Los Angeles-based actress and a graduate of the Acting for Camera AOS program at AMDA.

I’m currently looking to connect with filmmakers, student directors, photographers, and creatives for upcoming projects, short films, and collaborations.

I’m bilingual (Hebrew/English), comfortable with both dramatic and comedic material, and always excited to work on meaningful and visually interesting projects.

Headshots/reel available upon request — would love to connect!

🎬 POSZUKUJEMY STATYSTÓW DO FILMU KOSTIUMOWEGO!

Do ekranizacji znanej powieści (projekt MAGDY) poszukujemy statystów do udziału w zdjęciach.

📅 Terminy zdjęć (obowiązkowo oba dni):

11 sierpnia

13 sierpnia (ścisła kontynuacja scen)

📍 Lokalizacja: Warszawa i okolice. Zdjęcia realizowane będą pod Warszawą. Zapewniamy transport produkcyjny z Mokotowa.

🎥 Scena: Realizujemy jedną z najważniejszych scen filmu – opuszczenie mieszkańców ze spalonej miejscowości.

Przymiarki kostiumów

📅 6 lub 7 sierpnia 📍 Mokotów ⏱️ Czas trwania: około 1 godziny

Wynagrodzenie

180 zł netto za każdy dzień zdjęciowy

50 zł netto za przymiarkę

Łącznie: 410 zł netto.

Wynagrodzenie wypłacane gotówką drugiego dnia zdjęciowego.

Wymagania

Poszukujemy wyłącznie osób o naturalnym wyglądzie:

bez zabiegów medycyny estetycznej,

bez makijażu permanentnego brwi,

bez hybryd i pomalowanych paznokci,

bez tatuaży w widocznych miejscach,

bez włosów strzyżonych maszynką oraz bez współczesnych fryzur.

Zgłoszenia

📧 Wyślij zgłoszenie na adres: juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

Tytuł wiadomości: BB 113

W treści zgłoszenia prosimy o przesłanie:

aktualnych zdjęć twarzy i sylwetki (bez makijażu),

Panowie: zdjęcie z profilu oraz tyłu fryzury,

Panie: zdjęcie w rozpuszczonych włosach,

imienia i nazwiska, wieku, wzrostu, informacji o posiadanych tatuażach, numeru telefonu.

Zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Hi everyone. I’m seeking an agent for my scripts (varied from tv to features). I’ve had a small amount of shorts sold, won several contests for my features, etc.
Now, I’ve had bad experiences with “agents” in the past and hoping on here I can find a true agent who knows his/her worth as an agent and can participate in my getting my work sold (I’ve had actors (not major, but on Hallmark?) call me on the phone to say they loved my feature (Butterflies in the Sun) and wanted to do the lead part, but I couldn’t raise the $150,000 to have it produced on my own or even with a partner).
So if you’re still interested and still reading, please feel free to reach out to me via messenger. Thanks!

Hi everyone! My name is Autumn, and I’m based in Los Angeles. I’m passionate about film, entertainment, and the creative process, and I absolutely LOVE being on set.

I’ve been working as a Production Assistant and Audio Assistant since October 2025, and I also bring extensive experience from administrative roles. I’m looking to grow my career within the industry and would love the opportunity to get my foot in the door at a larger film or entertainment studio, whether that’s through an administrative position, production support role, or as a PA on set.

I’m reaching out to this group in hopes that someone might have advice, connections, or insight into opportunities, hiring processes, or ways to get involved. Any guidance or leads would mean so much, and I’d truly appreciate anything you’re willing to share.

Thank you all so much! :))

Wer ist Mira Tzenov? 
 
Neu in Köln und schon mittendrin: Mira Tzenov bringt Leistungssport, Körperbeherrschung, Disziplin und ihre Leidenschaft für die Kamera zusammen. Schauspiel und unterschiedliche Charaktere faszinieren sie besonders. Doch wie kam sie eigentlich auf diesen Weg?
 
Zwischen Filmset und Interview 

Dieses Gespräch entstand spontan in einer Drehpause bei einem gemeinsamen Dreh in Köln. Mira erzählt Christian Weiße von ersten Darstellerfahrungen, ihrer Begeisterung fürs Schauspiel und davon, wie Training und Ernährungsumstellung ihren Körper verändert haben.
 
Und plötzlich läuft die Zeit 
 
Viel Zeit blieb uns nicht. Während die Kamera noch läuft, wartet bereits der gemeinsame Drehort. Deshalb endet unser Gespräch genauso spontan, wie es begonnen hat: Wir müssen zurück und ziemlich hektisch zum Filmset flitzen. 
 
Wenn Du Mira auf ihrem Weg vor der Kamera begleiten möchtest, schau Dir das Video an, teile es und lass ein Like da. Weitere Gespräche mit Mira und Christian Weiße folgen. 

#MiraTzenov #ChristianWeiße #Schauspiel #Filmset #Köln #Karrideo

Der Kino Mittwoch im Doppelpack auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

Um 17h startet bereits die 3. Open  Air Ausgabe mit Tipps zu den Freiluftkinos in Eggenburg, Mistelbach,  St Pölten und Wolkersdorf sowie einem Interview mit Herbert Marko.

und um 18h: MOVIETIME KW 32/2026

BÖSER EISMANN? MULTIMEDIA ALA KLEEM TV

Der neue Horror-Slasher "Ice Cream Man" von Regisseur Eli Roth startet in den deutschen und österreichischen Kinos. Ob dieser etwas taugt oder doch nur Durchschnittsware ist, erfahren Sie bei uns.

KleeM ist ein österreichischer Spezialdienstleister für Multimediadesign, Videotechnik und Event-Inszenierung aus Eibesthal/Mistelbach in Niederösterreich. Geleitet von der Veranstaltungstechnik-Meisterin Romana Spitzbart-Kleewein konzipiert und betreut das Unternehmen die visuelle und technische Umsetzung von Shows, Tourneen, Corporate Events und Ausstellungen. Mit ihr konnte Moderatorin Sarah Fuchs ein ausführliches Interview führen. 

Musikalisch präsentieren wir diesmal einen Streifzug durch 85 Jahre Soundtrack History.

Mittwoch 5.8.2026 von 17 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Walked, laughed and talked with models from my previous modeling agency @risetalentllc, took selfies with the ever so talented @lovetrinitydesigns and was so happy to model and play with my friend @gavinjmodels

As a thank you, on top of being able to showcase my talent, I received 20% off the 2 piece floral jean jacket, pleated skirt, and wine red long sleeve top by gbGirls. And of course we had to add our own style to match the western theme.

#westernstyle #confidence #fashionista #model

# **🚨 CASTING CALL: KEITH CRIMBLE 🚨**

One final paid role is available in RSVP, a new immersive dark-comedy horror experience taking place near Horsham, West Sussex, this October.

We’re looking for a brilliant male-presenting character actor to play Keith: a seemingly ordinary village-hall caretaker, devoted family man and keeper of far too many keys.

Must be confident with improvisation, audience interaction, comedy and horror. Playing age between 40 and 65. 

Final casting workshop:
📍 Warnham Village Hall, near Horsham
📅 Thursday 13 August
⏰ 12pm–4pm
💰 Paid role

Performances take place across selected Friday and Saturday evenings in October. Applicants must be able to travel reliably to Warnham.

To apply, email HI@EZRAIMMERSIVE.COM with:

• Headshot
• Acting CV, Spotlight or Mandy profile
• Showreel, if available
• Current location
• Confirmation that you can attend the casting workshop

Please tag or send this to anybody who might make a disturbingly good Keith.

🎬 POSZUKUJEMY STATYSTÓW DO FILMU KOSTIUMOWEGO!

Do ekranizacji znanej powieści (projekt MAGDY) poszukujemy statystów do udziału w zdjęciach.

📅 Terminy zdjęć (obowiązkowo oba dni):

11 sierpnia

13 sierpnia (ścisła kontynuacja scen)

📍 Lokalizacja: Warszawa i okolice. Zdjęcia realizowane będą pod Warszawą. Zapewniamy transport produkcyjny z Mokotowa.

🎥 Scena: Realizujemy jedną z najważniejszych scen filmu – opuszczenie mieszkańców ze spalonej miejscowości.

Przymiarki kostiumów

📅 6 lub 7 sierpnia 📍 Mokotów ⏱️ Czas trwania: około 1 godziny

Wynagrodzenie

180 zł netto za każdy dzień zdjęciowy

50 zł netto za przymiarkę

Łącznie: 410 zł netto.

Wynagrodzenie wypłacane gotówką drugiego dnia zdjęciowego.

Wymagania

Poszukujemy wyłącznie osób o naturalnym wyglądzie:

bez zabiegów medycyny estetycznej,

bez makijażu permanentnego brwi,

bez hybryd i pomalowanych paznokci,

bez tatuaży w widocznych miejscach,

bez włosów strzyżonych maszynką oraz bez współczesnych fryzur.

Zgłoszenia

📧 Wyślij zgłoszenie na adres: juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

Tytuł wiadomości: BB 113

W treści zgłoszenia prosimy o przesłanie:

aktualnych zdjęć twarzy i sylwetki (bez makijażu),

Panowie: zdjęcie z profilu oraz tyłu fryzury,

Panie: zdjęcie w rozpuszczonych włosach,

imienia i nazwiska, wieku, wzrostu, informacji o posiadanych tatuażach, numeru telefonu.

Zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

LA  INDEPENDENT ACTORS/ACTRESSES WANTED FOR TEST FOOTAGE FOR FEATURE
Looking for a small cast to help take some test footage around the SGV and Pasadena area. 

This footage is from a feature film of mine, the script is completed but only looking to film one or two scenes.

This is a comedy/drama set during COVID. 

No payment, however you can keep whatever footage is taken of you and I will cast you as a member of the cast on IMDB.

Test footage will be shot on a Panasonic G85, all footage will be shot outside during the day in a public area.

(Near downtown Pasadena - Colorado/Lake)

LEAD ACTRESS: mid 20s/white/blonde hair (bleach or natural)

LEAD ACTOR: mid 20s/hispanic or white/a bit overweight

This is a unified project with me as writer/director/producer. 

No online transactions of copyrighted content. (We don’t send scripts online)

Will need to meet beforehand a few days prior to shooting, you will be provided with a physical copy of the scene. (Usually at Tops burgers or the Inn & Out on Walnut)

Serious inquiries only.

Union/Non-union I don’t really care. 

- C. Tano

items.text:
A Note From The Moderator
Hey everyone, hope you’re well ☺️

I want to address something that comes up a lot in the group: unpaid casting posts.

I get the frustration. We’d all love to see more paid work. But putting extreme pressure on every filmmaker — especially those just starting out — to pay actors isn’t fair.

The truth is: not every production has funding yet. Securing budget is a long, difficult process with a lot of rejection. 

If a project is unpaid and that doesn’t work for you, that’s completely fine. The best move is to simply scroll past and not apply.

What isn’t okay is being aggressive or hostile toward filmmakers who are trying to create work with limited resources. As actors ourselves, we should know how hard it is to get anything made. Don't become consumed with a pompous attitude or entitlement mentality. 

Please give filmmakers a break. 

Going forward: any unnecessary aggression or hostility toward posters based on this subject will result in a ban and removal from the group.

Thank you for keeping this space respectful.

topComments.text: Tbh if they want paid work they should probably look on paid platforms.

KLEINDARSTELLERIN ÜBER 60 GESUCHT

Wir (UdK-Studentin, Mediengestalter Bild und Ton) suchen noch eine Kleindarstellerin für unseren Kurzspielfilm

„Danke, ich." Er soll beim KURZstummfilmfestival eingereicht werden.

Es handelt sich um einen Stummfilm mit dem Thema „blau".

Ein Drehbuch ist schon vorhanden.

Im besten Fall hast du BLAUE oder GRÜNE AUGEN und GRAUE HAARE (teilweise grau oder weiß ist auch in Ordnung)

SPIELALTER: ÜBER 60 (je älter, desto besser)

Ja es eine No-Budget-Produktion ist, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten. Für Verpflegung am Set ist gesorgt. Dafür eine Menge Spaß ein nettes Team und ein Drehtag in der Natur  Der Film soll Mitte September, voraussichtlich am 12./13.09. in Berlin gedreht werden.

Schick uns bei Interesse gerne hier eine Nachricht oder eine Email an juli.c1@gmx.de. Dann senden wir dir weitere Informationen zum Projekt. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

:)

Julia Collina

topComments.text: Schade dass sowas immer soooo weit weg ist.

sharedPost.text:
Po dwóch operacjach kręgosłupa lędźwiowego spędzam dużo czasu w domu, mając sporo wolnych chwil. Postanowiłem wykorzystać ten moment na korektę moich scenariuszy – filmowego oraz serialowego – które napisałem dekadę temu. Na kanwie jednego z nich w 2017 roku na rynku wydawniczym pojawiła się „Lila”, opublikowana nakładem Wydawnictwa Naukowego PWN. Dwa lata później nakładem tego samego wydawcy ukazało się jej drugie wydanie. W sierpniu 2023 roku wydałem pierwszą edycję „Lilki”, której self-publishingiem i dystrybucją zająłem się osobiście. W 2024 roku światło dzienne ujrzało drugie i zarazem ostatnie wydanie tej książki. Z kolei w sierpniu 2026 roku, rehabilitując się i bazując na tej zamykającej dorobek pozycji literackiej, dokończyłem prace nad serialową oraz fabularną wersją scenariusza „Lilka”. Może tym razem będę miał więcej szczęścia i uda mi się doprowadzić ten projekt do skutku. Łatwo nie będzie – barierą jest nie tylko budżet, ale też niewygodna, trudna tematyka, dotykająca historii ukraińskich nacjonalistów z lat czterdziestych ubiegłego stulecia. Mimo tych trudności nie odpuszczam. Bardzo bym sobie życzył, aby „Lilka” ożyła na małym czy dużym ekranie.
Trzymajcie mocno! ✊🏼✊🏼

✨ CASTING CALL: THE NORTH POLE EXPERIENCE ✨
Are you ready to bring the magic of Christmas to life? We are now casting dynamic, warm, and versatile performers for The North Pole Experience in Liverpool!

We are seeking performers of all genders (18+) for Principal, Supporting, and Operational roles across our festive attractions.

📍 Location: Liverpool (L17), United Kingdom

🎭 Roles: Principal, Supporting & Operational Roles

📆 Contract: Mid-November – Late December

What We’re Looking For
 * Principal Roles: Previous professional acting experience required.

 * Supporting & Operational Roles: Experience in entertainment or live performance is a plus, but enthusiastic newcomers with a passion for performing are welcome!

 * Personality: Strong, confident acting ability, natural stage warmth, and a true embodiment of the Christmas spirit.

📅 Key Dates (Full Availability Required)
 * Rehearsals: Select dates during week commencing 16th November. Role dependant.

 * Tech Rehearsals: 21st & 22nd November
 * Friends & Family Preview: 27th November
 * Opening Day: 28th November 🎅
 * Charity Day: 2nd December (select characters)
 * Show Days: 5th, 6th, 12th, 13th, 19th, 20th, 21st, 23rd & 24th December
 * Additional Performance Days (Otterspool Grotto - select characters): 4th, 10th, 11th, 17th & 18th December.

Working hours operate on staggered start and finish times from 8:00am onwards, with finishes from 5:30pm onwards depending on character allocation. Cast members should be prepared for full-day shifts however certain days will have later starts and/or earlier finishes.

💰 Pay & Perks
 * Performance Days: Paid at up to £160 per day (depending on role and experience).

 * Rehearsal Days: Paid hourly at National Minimum Wage (NMW) for your age group.

 * Perks: Complimentary lunch and refreshments provided on all performance days, free tickets for our Friends & Family Preview, plus staff discounts in our on-site merchandise shop.

📩 How to Apply
Please email casting@thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk with the following details:

 * Full Name & Contact Details (Phone number & email address)
 * Confirmation of Full Availability (Please note: We cannot consider applications with partial availability)
 * Relevant Performance/Entertainment Experience (if applicable)
 * Link to Spotlight / Showreel (Please do not attach large video files directly to the email)
 * Current Availability for In-Person Auditions

Help us bring the magic of Christmas to life — we can’t wait to make magic with you! ✨🎄.

www.thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk

items.text:
Every week actors tell us they're "too" something.

Too old.
Too young.
Too Black.
Too Indigenous.
Too Asian.
Too white.
Too gay.
Too different.

We’ve heard every version.

**But I've seen more actors hold themselves back than I've ever seen casting hold them back.**

As a former agent, I learned something that changed the way I coach actors forever. It made me realize that waiting for permission is one of the fastest ways to stall a career.

In this free class, we talk about why Hollywood has changed, why there are more opportunities than many actors realize, and what you can do to become ready for the opportunities that are still being written.

**I'd love to know what you think after you watch it.**

🎬 Replay:
[https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI](https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI)

**CASTING CALL**
**IT'S A LOVE HATE THING**

SYNOPSIS
**IT'S A LOVE HATE THING**

**Genre:** Romantic Comedy • Workplace Comedy

Bob Carter, a stubborn Texas copywriter, and Bennett, a brilliant, fiercely driven advertising executive, are forced to work together on the biggest client pitch of their careers. With just seventy-two hours to save their agency and win a multi-million dollar account, every brainstorming session turns into a battle of egos, sarcasm, and creative one-upmanship.

As the pressure mounts, the office erupts into hilarious chaos. A burned-out agency owner counting the days until retirement, an oblivious HR manager obsessed with morale campaigns and workplace policies, and an eccentric team of coworkers only add fuel to the fire. Between sleepless nights, impossible deadlines, and one disaster after another, Bob and Bennett slowly realize that the person who challenges them the most is also the one who inspires them.

Blending sharp workplace satire with heartfelt romance, **It's a Love Hate Thing** is a funny, fast-paced romantic comedy about ambition, chemistry, and discovering that sometimes the best relationships begin with the worst first impressions.

*Short Comedy/Drama • Workplace Film*

**Filming Location:** McKinney, TX & Anna, TX
**PAID**

**Lead Roles:** **$200/Day **
**Supporting Roles:** **Negotiable**
**All Meals Provided **

**Union/Non-Union **

**Leads**
**NOW CASTING**
* **Bob Carter** — Male, 40–45. Rugged Texas copywriter with dry wit, stubborn creativity, and zero patience for corporate nonsense.
* **Bennett** — Female, 30–35. Fearless Australian advertising executive with razor-sharp sarcasm and an obsession with winning.

Supporting
* **Billy Crenshaw** — Male, 50–56. Burned-out agency owner who's held together by coffee, antacids, and pure sarcasm.
* **Karen (The HR Lady)** — Female, 40–60. Endlessly cheerful HR representative armed with motivational posters, policy binders, and impeccable timing for making everything more awkward.
* **Jason** — Male, 20s–30s. Tech-savvy creative whose shortcuts usually create twice as many problems as they solve.
* **Lea** — Female, early to mid-20s. Sharp, observant Gen Z creative. Quick to spot hypocrisy, never afraid to call it out, and constantly questioning the absurdity of corporate culture.

**Send Headshot, Resume & Demo Reel to:**
**info.lovehate27@gmail.com**

**Submission Deadline:** September 1, 2026
**Virtual Auditions:** September 15, 2026
**Shoot Dates:** 3 Days • **TBD – 2027**

**Content Advisory:** This production contains strong language, smoking, drug use, sexual content, adult themes, and satirical workplace humor. It is intentionally irreverent and may offend some people. If edgy, R-rated workplace comedy isn't your thing, this project may not be for you.

With just seventy-two hours to save their agency and win a multi-million dollar account, every brainstorming session turns into a battle of egos, sarcasm, and creative one-upmanship.

As the pressure mounts, the office erupts into hilarious chaos. A burned-out agency owner counting the days until retirement, an oblivious HR manager obsessed with morale campaigns and workplace policies, and an eccentric team of coworkers only add fuel to the fire. Between sleepless nights, impossible deadlines, and one disaster after another, Bob and Bennett slowly realize that the person who challenges them the most is also the one who inspires them.

Blending sharp workplace satire with heartfelt romance, **It's a Love Hate Thing** is a funny, fast-paced romantic comedy about ambition, chemistry, and discovering that sometimes the best relationships begin with the worst first impressions.

*Short Comedy/Drama • Workplace Film*

**Filming Location:** McKinney, TX & Anna, TX
**PAID**

**Lead Roles:** **$200/Day **
**Supporting Roles:** **Negotiable**
**All Meals Provided **

**Union/Non-Union **

**Leads**
**NOW CASTING**
* **Bob Carter** — Male, 40–45. Rugged Texas copywriter with dry wit, stubborn creativity, and zero patience for corporate nonsense.
* **Bennett** — Female, 30–35. Fearless Australian advertising executive with razor-sharp sarcasm and an obsession with winning.

Supporting
* **Billy Crenshaw** — Male, 50–56. Burned-out agency owner who's held together by coffee, antacids, and pure sarcasm.
* **Karen (The HR Lady)** — Female, 40–60. Endlessly cheerful HR representative armed with motivational posters, policy binders, and impeccable timing for making everything more awkward.
* **Jason** — Male, 20s–30s. Tech-savvy creative whose shortcuts usually create twice as many problems as they solve.
* **Lea** — Female, early to mid-20s. Sharp, observant Gen Z creative. Quick to spot hypocrisy, never afraid to call it out, and constantly questioning the absurdity of corporate culture.

**Send Headshot, Resume & Demo Reel to:**
**info.lovehate27@gmail.com**

**Submission Deadline:** September 1, 2026
**Virtual Auditions:** September 15, 2026
**Shoot Dates:** 3 Days • **TBD – 2027**

**Content Advisory:** This production contains strong language, smoking, drug use, sexual content, adult themes, and satirical workplace humor. It is intentionally irreverent and may offend some people. If edgy, R-rated workplace comedy isn't your thing, this project may not be for you.

Every week actors tell us they're "too" something.

Too old.
Too young.
Too Black.
Too Indigenous.
Too Asian.
Too white.
Too gay.
Too different.

We’ve heard every version.

**But I've seen more actors hold themselves back than I've ever seen casting hold them back.**

As a former agent, I learned something that changed the way I coach actors forever. It made me realize that waiting for permission is one of the fastest ways to stall a career.

In this free class, we talk about why Hollywood has changed, why there are more opportunities than many actors realize, and what you can do to become ready for the opportunities that are still being written.

**I'd love to know what you think after you watch it.**

🎬 Replay:
[https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI](https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI)

## Child performer  – short documentary on Heston Blumenthal and The Fat Duck

Hi all - I’m Theo Gee, a documentary director, and I’m currently making a short documentary about Heston Blumenthal and The Fat Duck. I’m getting in touch to see whether you represent any young performers who might be suitable for a small but important recreation role.

We are looking for a **white male child performer with a playing age of approximately 8–10** to portray a young Heston Blumenthal.

The ideal performer would have:
* Dark, auburn or ginger hair
* A medium-to-small build
* Short hair or a buzz cut, or a parent who would be open to discussing a shorter haircut
* Confidence in front of the camera
* A genuine interest in cooking and comfort working in a kitchen

There is no dialogue, and the performance will involve fairly simple actions and reactions: preparing food, tasting, experimenting, becoming excited, concentrating and occasionally appearing tired or frustrated.

Extensive acting experience is not essential. We are primarily looking for someone natural, curious, easy to direct and comfortable exploring ideas on camera.

The child does not need advanced culinary skills, but they should be confident handling ingredients and following instructions in a professional kitchen. During the shoot, they will receive specific guidance from one of the senior chefs at The Fat Duck to help make the cooking authentic.

**Shoot details**

Location: The Fat Duck, Bray, near Maidenhead
Commitment: One weekday shoot day only
Likely timing: Late September or early October 2026
Exact date: To be confirmed around the restaurant’s operating schedule
Dialogue: None
Usage: YouTube and The Fat Duck group’s owned channels only
Television or paid advertising use: None
Fee: Expenses-only, with reasonable travel and related costs for the child and accompanying parent or guardian covered

This is a self-funded passion project (not commissioned at all by Heston or The Fat Duck) —one of a small number of films I make each year to explore people and stories I’m fascinated by—and the entire crew is contributing their time unpaid. Unfortunately, the role would therefore also be unpaid, but all reasonable travel and related expenses for the child and accompanying parent or guardian would be covered. A clear contract will set out the agreed usage, permissions and limitations. We will also handle all relevant child performance licensing, safeguarding and supervision requirements.

You can see examples of my previous work here:

[https://www.theogee.net/work](https://www.theogee.net/work)

This previous film about a chef gives a useful reference for the standard of my work, although the tone of this project will be very different. Please note that it contains quite a lot of swearing:

[https://www.theogee.net/work/a-knife-in-the-valley](https://www.theogee.net/work/a-knife-in-the-valley)

Just putting feelers out right now - there is no need for a formal audition initially. ## Child performer  – short documentary on Heston Blumenthal and The Fat Duck

Hi all - I’m Theo Gee, a documentary director, and I’m currently making a short documentary about Heston Blumenthal and The Fat Duck. I’m getting in touch to see whether you represent any young performers who might be suitable for a small but important recreation role.

We are looking for a **white male child performer with a playing age of approximately 8–10** to portray a young Heston Blumenthal.

The ideal performer would have:
* Dark, auburn or ginger hair
* A medium-to-small build
* Short hair or a buzz cut, or a parent who would be open to discussing a shorter haircut
* Confidence in front of the camera
* A genuine interest in cooking and comfort working in a kitchen

There is no dialogue, and the performance will involve fairly simple actions and reactions: preparing food, tasting, experimenting, becoming excited, concentrating and occasionally appearing tired or frustrated.

Extensive acting experience is not essential. We are primarily looking for someone natural, curious, easy to direct and comfortable exploring ideas on camera.

The child does not need advanced culinary skills, but they should be confident handling ingredients and following instructions in a professional kitchen. During the shoot, they will receive specific guidance from one of the senior chefs at The Fat Duck to help make the cooking authentic.

**Shoot details**

Location: The Fat Duck, Bray, near Maidenhead
Commitment: One weekday shoot day only
Likely timing: Late September or early October 2026
Exact date: To be confirmed around the restaurant’s operating schedule
Dialogue: None
Usage: YouTube and The Fat Duck group’s owned channels only
Television or paid advertising use: None
Fee: Expenses-only, with reasonable travel and related costs for the child and accompanying parent or guardian covered

This is a self-funded passion project (not commissioned at all by Heston or The Fat Duck) —one of a small number of films I make each year to explore people and stories I’m fascinated by—and the entire crew is contributing their time unpaid. Unfortunately, the role would therefore also be unpaid, but all reasonable travel and related expenses for the child and accompanying parent or guardian would be covered. A clear contract will set out the agreed usage, permissions and limitations. We will also handle all relevant child performance licensing, safeguarding and supervision requirements.

You can see examples of my previous work here:

[https://www.theogee.net/work](https://www.theogee.net/work)

This previous film about a chef gives a useful reference for the standard of my work, although the tone of this project will be very different. Please note that it contains quite a lot of swearing:

[https://www.theogee.net/work/a-knife-in-the-valley](https://www.theogee.net/work/a-knife-in-the-valley)

Just putting feelers out right now - there is no need for a formal audition initially.  For anyone who feels like a potential fit, I would just need some recent photos, and would then arrange a short video call with a parent or guardian present, to explain the project and get to know them a little.

Feel free to email me at theogee@hotmail.com

Thanks!

items.text: Any advice in getting my son in horror? He has an agent. I am just looking for additional ways.

topComments.text:
Is he a trained actor? 

Unfortunately you can’t really pick a genre of films and only pursue that. 

If you have taken years of acting classes and are a well rounded and skilled actor, any agent you sign with is going to want to send you out on everything from romantic comedies to Disney tv shows. You can’t sign with an agency and say “horror films only please”. It doesn’t work that way unfortunately.
You don't pick genres. Get an agent and they submit to all castings that he is suitable for. Agents don't let you pick and choose.

Why Every Actor Should Learn to Act Badly On Purpose
What if I told you that one of the fastest ways to discover truthful acting is to act badly on purpose?

In this clip from a previous Bad Acting class, the same moment is performed three ways: overplayed, underplayed and natural.

The natural take isn’t simply quieter—or somewhere in between. By deliberately exaggerating different acting habits, actors can identify exactly what makes a performance feel false and then recalibrate without losing freedom, impulse or playfulness.

That’s what we’ll explore in the Bad Acting Masterclass on Sunday, August 16.
